official_questions.stem:
Which of the following statement/statements is/are valid in connection with Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs) ?
I. Achieving Goal 10 will require an entire reform of the financial system that promotes equitable pay and decent work for young people.
II. NITI Aayog has developed the National Indicator Framework (NIF) for facilitating monitoring of SDGs in India.
III. 'Mission LiFE' aims to influence government and industrial policy to support both sustainable consumption and production.
IV. The concept of global citizenship embedded in Sustainable Development Goal 4 (SDG 4) is a reference term that indicates flexible citizenship rights across countries for the purpose of facilitating better labour markets.
Select the correct answer using the codes given below :
official_questions.core_fact: SDG 8 = decent work and growth; SDG 10 = reduced inequalities; NIF was developed by MoSPI (NITI Aayog makes the SDG India Index); Mission LiFE (2022) targets individual behaviour and government/industry policy for sustainable consumption and production; 'global citizenship' in SDG 4.7 is an education value.

statements.t: Achieving Goal 10 will require an entire reform of the financial system that promotes equitable pay and decent work for young people.
statements.fact: Equitable pay and decent work for young people belong to SDG 8.

statements.t: NITI Aayog has developed the National Indicator Framework (NIF) for facilitating monitoring of SDGs in India.
statements.fact: MoSPI developed the National Indicator Framework; NITI Aayog compiles the SDG India Index.

statements.t: 'Mission LiFE' aims to influence government and industrial policy to support both sustainable consumption and production.

The concept of global citizenship embedded in Sustainable Development Goal 4 (SDG 4) is a reference term that indicates flexible citizenship rights across countries for the purpose of facilitating better labour markets.
statements.fact: Global citizenship in SDG 4.7 refers to education promoting shared values and global awareness, not cross-border rights.

official_questions.rule: NIF = MoSPI; SDG India Index = NITI; decent work = SDG 8.

official_questions.stem:
Which of the following statements are valid regarding Human Development ?
I. Two countries with the same level of Gross National Income (GNI) per capita, but ending with different human development outcomes is indicative of the importance of growth over development.
II. A country's score on the Inequality-Adjusted Human Development Index (IHDI) is not the same as its Human Development Index (HDI) even when there is no inequality among people.
III. In Gender Development Index (GDI), values below 1 indicate higher development for women than men.
IV. Planetary Pressures-adjusted Human Development Index (PHDI) focuses on intergenerational inequality just the same way, as the Inequality-adjusted Human Development Index (IHDI) focuses on intragenerational inequality.
V. According to the Human Development Report 2021 - 22, a new uncertainty complex is emerging, which comprises of three new concerns — planetary changes, sweeping social transformations and polarized societies.
Select the correct answer using the codes given below :
official_questions.core_fact: IHDI equals HDI when there is no inequality; GDI = female HDI / male HDI (below 1 = women behind); PHDI adjusts HDI for planetary pressures (intergenerational), IHDI for intragenerational inequality; HDR 2021-22 'uncertainty complex' = planetary change, social transformation, polarisation.

statements.t: Two countries with the same level of Gross National Income (GNI) per capita, but ending with different human development outcomes is indicative of the importance of growth over development.
statements.fact: Same GNI with different outcomes shows that policy and human development matter beyond income growth.

statements.t: A country's score on the Inequality-Adjusted Human Development Index (IHDI) is not the same as its Human Development Index (HDI) even when there is no inequality among people.
statements.d: not the same ... even when there is no inequality
statements.fact: With no inequality IHDI equals HDI.

statements.t: In Gender Development Index (GDI), values below 1 indicate higher development for women than men.
statements.d: values below 1 indicate higher development for women
statements.fact: GDI below 1 means lower development for women than men.

statements.t: Planetary Pressures-adjusted Human Development Index (PHDI) focuses on intergenerational inequality just the same way, as the Inequality-adjusted Human Development Index (IHDI) focuses on intragenerational inequality.

According to the Human Development Report 2021 - 22, a new uncertainty complex is emerging, which comprises of three new concerns — planetary changes, sweeping social transformations and polarized societies.

official_questions.rule: GDI < 1 = women behind; IHDI = HDI if no inequality; PHDI = intergenerational.
